title: Monitor-Robustness Benchmark for CoT Safety Monitors

original_idea.body: # Monitor-Robustness Benchmark for CoT Safety Monitors. Apply graded obfuscation transforms to labeled CoT traces; measure monitor recall drop; output ROC-vs-obfuscation curves. Release labeled set.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Measuring monitor margin under obfuscation directly serves CoT-monitoring safety cases.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Obfuscation transforms + monitor-recall scoring via prompting; accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused ROC-vs-obfuscation benchmark; curating labeled traces is moderate effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Reusable monitor-evaluation set; labs underweight third-party monitor audits.

novelty.reasoning: Obfuscation stress-tests exist; a dedicated monitor-robustness ROC benchmark plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Related stress-tests exist; dedicated monitor-robustness benchmark plausibly open.
